# Index

This project develops and validates a predictive model for patient outcomes in the DCD (Donation after Circulatory Death) pipeline. The analysis focuses on strictly preventing data leakage through group-aware validation.

## Project Structure

The analysis is organized into the following stages:

1. **[Data Processing](00_process-data.qmd)**: Cleaning, normalization, and construction of the final analytic dataset.
2. **[Exploratory Data Analysis](01_explore-data.qmd)**: Distribution analysis, missingness patterns, and initial cohort characterization.
3. **[Statistical Analysis](02_analyze-data.qmd)**: Univariate and pooled logistic regression to identify primary clinical drivers.
4. **[Predictive Modeling](03_model.qmd)**: Implementation of RF, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression with nested, group-aware cross-validation.
5. **[Model Explainability](04_analyze-model.qmd)**: SHAP-based feature importance and alignment with clinical evidence.
